pending.why: NuScale: only NRC-certified SMR design, under $10 after an earnings miss. Certification is the scarce asset if the power shortage forces a bid.
Nano Nuclear: smallest cap, behind-the-meter microreactors. Highest beta to the same shortage. Lottery-ticket sizing.
GE Vernova: turbines and grid gear deliver power on the BINDING 2026-27 timeline, order books sold out.
Quanta: builds the interconnection itself. Least conditional way to be long the bottleneck.
Vistra: already-interconnected generation with spare capacity — the one thing hyperscalers can actually buy today.
